segments.name: Eco tanker segment
segments.description: Operates the eco-design tanker M/T Wonder Altair and the legacy Handysize vessel M/T Wonder Mimosa for charterers under period time charters.
segments.evidence: The M/T Wonder Mimosa is a 2010-built Handysize vessel that does not have eco-design characteristics, but its results are included within the Eco tanker segment as the successor to the former Handysize tanker segment.

segments.name: Non-Eco tanker segment
segments.description: Operates the non-eco design tanker M/T Wonder Maia for charterers under period time charters.
segments.evidence: As a result we operated in three reportable segments: (i) the Eco tanker segment (comprising of M/T Wonder Altair as discussed above), (ii) the Non-Eco tanker segment (comprising of M/T Wonder Maia ) and the (iii) LPG carrier segment (comprising of LPG Dream Arrax and LPG Dream Vermax ) and, each on a continuing operations basis.

segments.name: LPG carrier segment
segments.description: Operates LPG carrier vessels transporting liquefied petroleum gas for charterers under period time charters.
segments.evidence: As a result, Toro operated in three reportable segments: (i) the Eco tanker segment (comprising of M/T Wonder Altair as discussed above), (ii) the Non-Eco tanker segment (comprising of M/T Wonder Maia ) and (iii) LPG carrier segment (comprising of LPG Dream Arrax and LPG Dream Vermax ), each on a continuing operations basis.

revenueModel.text: Charterers pay fixed or floating daily hire rates under time charters, and vessel cargoes generate voyage charter freight.
revenueModel.evidence: Under our time charter agreements, whereby our vessels are utilized by a charterer for a set duration of time, the charterer pays a fixed or floating daily hire rate and other compensation costs related to the contracts.

changes.text: In 2024 the company sold the M/T Wonder Sirius and reported the related tanker segment as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: Following the sale of the M/T Wonder Sirius in January of 2024, we no longer had any Aframax/LR2 vessels and the results of operations and cash flows of the Aframax/LR2 segment, as well as its assets and liabilities, are reported as discontinued operations.

changes.text: In 2025 the former Handysize tanker segment was renamed to reflect the updated fleet composition and the strategic continuity of the segment.
changes.evidence: Following the Robin Spin-Off of the Handysize tanker vessel and the acquisition of the new MR (MR2 class) tanker vessel, M/T Wonder Altair (built in 2021) on July 11, 2025, the former Handysize segment was renamed "MR (Handysize/MR2)" to reflect both the updated fleet composition and the strategic continuity of the segment.

changes.text: In 2025 the tanker segments were reassessed and an additional Non-Eco tanker segment was created alongside the Eco tanker segment.
changes.evidence: the Company reassessed its segments and the MR (Handysize/MR2) segment was replaced with the Eco tanker segment and an additional Non-Eco tanker segment was created.
